scripts.build:web: git -C opencode reset -q 2>/dev/null; git -C opencode apply -R ../overlay/android-app.patch 2>/dev/null; git -C opencode checkout -- bun.lock 2>/dev/null; git -C opencode apply --3way ../overlay/android-app.patch && bun install --cwd opencode && rm -rf www && VITE_PLATFORM=android bun run --cwd opencode/packages/app build && cp -R opencode/packages/app/dist www && git -C opencode reset -q && git -C opencode apply -R ../overlay/android-app.patch && git -C opencode checkout -- bun.lock
scripts.sync: bun run build:web && bunx cap sync android
